name: Montreal / Pierre Elliott Trudeau International Airport

inferredApronConnectors.note: 28 estimated straight extensions from mapped stand centerlines to adjacent mapped taxiways, each under 25 m. Names and approximate terminal/apron areas are shown in the 2024 simulation briefing; connector geometry is inferred, not independently mapped or surveyed. Eleven terminal gate nodes were separately checked within 34 m of the mapped parking endpoints; these nodes identify terminal gates, not aircraft stop coordinates.
